channel.title: Rizwan Zafar — Payments Essays
channel.description: Essays on payment infrastructure, fintech product, risk, settlement, AI and program leadership.

item.title: Sanctions Screening Without Killing Throughput
item.description: How to design sanctions screening that catches what it must catch without flooding ops with false positives or breaking real-time transaction performance.

item.title: AML/CFT: Rules vs Models, and Why You Need Both
item.description: Where rules belong, where models belong, and how to design an AML/CFT detection stack that is both defensible to regulators and effective at catching real bad actors.

item.title: How Emerging Markets Pressure-Test Payment Product Strategy
item.description: What payment product teams from Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, and Adyen learn the hard way when they ship into Pakistan, Bangladesh, Egypt, and Iraq.

item.title: PCI DSS and ISO 27001 as Product Programs
item.description: What it takes to lead PCI DSS and ISO 27001 programs from scratch at a payments platform, scoping, evidence, controls, and the trap of treating compliance as paperwork.

item.title: Chargebacks Are a Product Problem
item.description: How to treat chargebacks as a product surface, root-cause categorisation, prevention, representment, and the feedback loop that actually reduces the rate.

item.title: Payment Cost Is a Product Variable: From 50% to 1% (Tapmad Migration Playbook)
item.description: How a subscription business cut payment cost from ~50% of revenue to ~1% by treating cost as a product variable, rail mix, dunning, smart retries.

item.title: Payments PRD Template: The 9 Sections Every Senior PM Should Write
item.description: A practical payments PRD template for senior product managers covering rail choice, risk, settlement, compliance, operations and launch gates.

item.title: Layered Fraud Controls in the Payments Stack
item.description: How to design layered fraud controls across device, identity, transaction, behavioural and network layers, without crushing conversion or throughput.

item.title: The Risk-Adjusted Backlog: Prioritising Payment Products When Failure Costs Real Money
item.description: How senior payment product teams prioritise roadmaps when revenue, compliance, fraud, settlement risk and reliability all compete.

item.title: KYC and Conversion Designed Together
item.description: Why KYC and conversion are the same product surface, how to design identity verification flows that compliance accepts and merchants actually finish.

item.title: Why Local Payment Methods Are a Developer-Experience Problem
item.description: Acceptance in emerging markets is decided at the SDK and webhook layer. Why local payment methods are developer-experience problems first.

item.title: PMO Maturity Model for Fintech: Five Stages and How to Know Yours
item.description: A practical five-stage PMO maturity model for fintech and payments teams, from delivery tracking to regulated execution system.

item.title: Cross-Border Corridors Are Operating Systems, Not Routes
item.description: A corridor is not a partner integration. It is a product with its own success rate, FX behavior, compliance overlay, and unit economics. A practitioner view from MENA and South Asia.

item.title: Financial Controls Are Product Requirements, Not Compliance Afterthoughts
item.description: Why financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trails, maker-checker, reversals, are product requirements, not compliance afterthoughts.

item.title: Onboarding Conversion vs. Default Rate: The Real Tradeoff
item.description: How to manage the real tradeoff between onboarding conversion and downstream default, fraud, and chargeback rates without picking a side.

item.title: Vendor Governance in Fintech: The PMO Surface Most Teams Underestimate
item.description: How fintech PMOs should govern vendors across payments, OTT, banking and regulated transformation programs without slowing delivery.

item.title: KYB Document Extraction: A Realistic LLM Use Case in Regulated Payments
item.description: A realistic architecture for using LLMs in KYB document extraction while keeping risk decisions auditable and compliance-controlled.

item.title: Risk Tiering Merchants Is a Product Decision
item.description: Why merchant risk tiering belongs to product, not just risk, how tiers shape onboarding, limits, settlement, fees, and the entire merchant lifecycle.

item.title: Agentic Payments Operations: What Works, What Is Theatre
item.description: A practical view of agentic AI in payments operations: where agents help, where deterministic workflows win, and how to control production risk.

item.title: KYB Automation Without Blowing Up Risk
item.description: How to automate KYB onboarding for merchants without inflating fraud, sanctions, or default rates, tiering, data sources, and the review queue that scales.

item.title: Ledger Design for Multi-Rail Payments
item.description: How to design a double-entry payment ledger that holds across cards, wallets, IBFT, DCB and cross-border rails at $1B+ GTV, entities, postings, and invariants.

item.title: Regulatory UX: Why the Name on a Payment Screen Can Block a Launch
item.description: An operator essay on regulatory UX, why the words, names, and disclosures on a payment screen can be the difference between a launch and a six-month delay.

item.title: Exception Management in Reconciliation
item.description: How to design exception management for payment reconciliation so finance ops scales sublinearly with GTV, taxonomy, routing, SLAs, and product feedback loops.

item.title: Merchant Onboarding: Where Growth, Risk and Compliance Collide
item.description: Why merchant onboarding is a single product surface where growth, risk, and compliance must be designed together, not by three separate teams.

item.title: Hosted Checkout vs Direct Card Processing: A Product Maturity Guide (MPGS, MDES, 3DS)
item.description: Hosted checkout ships fast. Direct card processing ships maturity. A practitioner walk-through of MPGS, MDES, tokenization, 3DS, and PCI scope decisions.

item.title: Settlement Windows and Merchant Trust
item.description: Settlement timing is the most underrated product surface in payments. How T+0, T+1 and T+n settlement windows shape merchant trust, cashflow, and churn.

item.title: BIN Routing and Scheme Selection: When To Override the Card-Brand Default
item.description: The operator's guide to BIN routing, co-badged cards, scheme selection logic, regulator pressure on choice of brand, the four override patterns that move auth rate, and the six failure modes acquirers ship without realising.

item.title: Click to Pay (VCTP / MCTP): The Scheme-Led Checkout Standard, How It Actually Works
item.description: Click to Pay explained from the operator's lens — what VCTP and MCTP actually are, the merchant + issuer + consumer surface, why it shipped, where it works, where it's still patchy.

item.title: Compelling Evidence 3.0 (Visa): What Changed, and How To Actually Win Disputes Now
item.description: An operator's read of Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0, the new evidence rules, the prior-undisputed-transaction lookback, the data fields acquirers must capture, and the seven moves that flip the dispute win rate.

item.title: CSPO + RICE in Practice: A Real Payments Roadmap Walkthrough
item.description: How a CSPO-trained payments PM actually uses RICE on a live quarter. The eight roadmap items, real reach and confidence inputs, the risk-adjusted overlay payments demands, and the four moves the framework gets wrong on its own.
